venues.trending_copy: Paddock Bakery runs out of a restored weatherboard cottage in Miami, and the picket-fence courtyard is doing as much work as the pastry counter. Get a croissant out the back before 9am; the courtyard tables go well before the morning does.
venues.must_try: Croissants, rustic sourdough, seasonal pastries, specialty coffee in the courtyard

venues.trending_copy: Bam Bam's Nutella choux bombs are the reason Mermaid Beach forms a queue, and the regulars will tell you they're non-negotiable. The nasi goreng breakfast is the sleeper order — proof the kitchen isn't only here for the pastry counter.
venues.must_try: Jalapeño & queso fresco sweetcorn fritters, nasi goreng breakfast, Nutella choux bombs (non-negotiable), pastries & dessert pots
